sentences.en: Our quarterly results will serve as the best appraisal of our approach.
sentences.zh: 我们的季度业绩将是对我们方法的最佳评估。

sentences.en: Tom generally makes good decisions based on a realistic appraisal of the situation he's faced with.
sentences.zh: 汤姆通常会基于对所面临情况的现实评估做出明智的决策。

sentences.en: The property appraisal was higher than expected.
sentences.zh: 房产评估比预期的要高。

senses.zh: 评价，估量,鉴定，估价（尤指估价财产，以便征税）
